trace_rule: Resolve selectors with an independent patch decoder. Freeze exact anchors, expected grids, fallback states, and public commands before changed-viewer timings.
scope: Single-viewer product acceptance, not a comparison benchmark.

latency.start: Actual public-command injection, before the first byte including any numeric prefix; opening starts immediately before process spawn.
latency.completion: First complete PTY grid with independently expected source content and destination. A cursor-only change does not complete a scroll sample.
latency.on_late_completion: Delay the next injection. Retain the late sample.

forward.setup: First source viewport, with at least 120 display rows remaining.
forward.command: SGR mouse-wheel down at a fixed code cell
forward.expected: Each input advances the viewport by the specified three display rows.

reverse.setup: End state of the forward category.
reverse.command: SGR mouse-wheel up at the same code cell
reverse.expected: Each input reverses three display rows; the final viewport matches the forward start.

distant_seek.setup: Input/index ready, first available source row.
distant_seek.expected: Alternating last and first available source rows, with complete expected grids.

layout.setup: Middle supplied source line in the largest hunk; split layout.
layout.expected: Alternate unified/split, retaining source identity and the permitted screen-relative anchor.

resize.setup: Same largest-hunk anchor, split layout, 160x50 cells.
resize.expected: Correct geometry and retained source identity, without stale cells.

reducers.scope: Each fixture and each category separately; never pooled.
reducers.p95: Sort all 200 samples ascending; choose one-based rank ceil(0.95 * 200), which is 190.
reducers.failure_rule: A wrong grid, lost input, timeout, or missing changed-viewer operation fails acceptance. Unsupported baseline operations remain explicit missing data.
reducers.incomplete_series: Do not report a passing percentile from a shortened series.

structural_selectors.file_quantiles: Unique ascending floor(i * (file_count - 1) / 31), for i = 0..31, including metadata-only files.
structural_selectors.largest_hunk: Greatest count of supplied patch source records; context counts once.
structural_selectors.longest_line: Greatest source-byte length, excluding the patch sign and physical delimiter.
structural_selectors.tie_break: Earliest file, hunk, then source-record ordinal in patch order.
structural_selectors.style_targets: Midpoint and final supplied source line of the largest hunk; midpoint of the largest file's supplied source sequence; longest line.
structural_selectors.side_choice: New side when present, otherwise old side.
structural_selectors.fallback_inventory: Freeze selected grammar, missing-context status, and the existing 10000-scalar fallback for every target. Unknown syntax is not a discretionary large-input shortcut.
structural_selectors.public_navigation: Use public counted file/hunk/row/page/horizontal movement. Record the whole setup sequence and final measured command. No hidden jump API.
structural_selectors.unsupported_baseline: Record missing counted-navigation coverage; do not pretend the old executable implements the new commands.

styling.cold_trials: Each designated target gets five fresh-process trials. Freeze a source-derived approach using counted movement. Record target cache misses and the nearest checkpoint/replay distance; approaching through intermediate styled viewports does not qualify as cold.
styling.cold_start: Injection of the final public command that exposes the target viewport.
styling.cold_completion: Every visible source line has its expected final syntax/inline style or its predeclared context/fallback status.
styling.revisit_trials: Leave the target viewport, then return once without changing theme or layout. Record checkpoint/cache retention and replay distance.
styling.eviction_rule: An evicted revisit is a cold sample, remains in the report, and must meet the cold limit. It is not counted as a retained-checkpoint pass.
styling.reference: Sequential highlighting from each actual known source-context boundary; never initialize parser state at an arbitrary seek destination.

memory.anchor_order: File-quantile headers in ascending order, then style targets in their declared order, with exact duplicate source anchors removed.
memory.per_anchor: Reach the anchor through public controls. Check its split grid and settled styles, toggle unified and check again, then restore split.
memory.long_line_tail: On the longest source line, page through all wrapped segments once; then check its unwrapped first, middle, and last visible cell ranges with counted horizontal movement. Freeze the exact public inputs.
memory.steady_rss: Maximum process-group RSS during the third tour's one-second settled holds at every checked viewport, including the long-line cases.
memory.peak_rss: From process spawn through exit, including ingestion, all three tours, and transient work.
memory.scope: Viewer and all owned workers/helpers; report terminal RSS separately. Threads belong to the viewer process and are not double-counted.
memory.coverage_note: These tours sample rendered viewports. The independent full-content check covers every supplied source segment.

correctness_variants.rapid_input: Inject 20 wheel-down events then 20 wheel-up events at 5 ms intervals from a fixed interior viewport. Verify the final expected viewport and no direction/input loss.
correctness_variants.lifecycle: Real FIFO: complete A, blocked B, complete B; then malformed B and EOF. Repeat cancellation while blocked and while styling.
correctness_variants.full_content: Compare all supplied bytes, side identities, ranges, metadata, and newline markers against independent reference digests.

targets.first_content_requirement: At least one actual source line with correct file/hunk context; a loading screen, header, or metadata-only card is insufficient.
targets.non_percentile_gate: Use the maximum of all applicable repeats for opening, indexing, styling, quit, and memory. Also report medians.

visual_evidence.surface: Existing visible Ghostty window; no automatic window creation or preference changes.
visual_evidence.recording_pass: Separate from unrecorded PTY timing; one short representative clip per fixture.
visual_evidence.claim_limit: PTY-grid completion is not a pixel-presentation timestamp. Missing GUI access blocks visual signoff, not engine work.
